entities.summary: BD+20 2457 is a 10th-magnitude K-type bright giant star located approximately 4,800 light-years away in the constellation of Leo. The name refers to the Bonner Durchmusterung star catalog. This star contains a very small amount of metals, containing only 10% as enriched with elements heavier than hydrogen and helium as the Sun.
